project.title: Two-stage purge catcher and freestanding lower bin for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max

coordinate_frame.origin: center of catcher outlet on its lowest plane

requirements.statement: A small mounted catcher shall stop ejected purge fragments and redirect them downward.
requirements.verification: geometry review and three supervised purge cycles

requirements.statement: A separate freestanding bin shall collect waste below without loading the printer-side mount.
requirements.verification: assembly preview and physical placement check

requirements.statement: The supplied stacked metriMade lockup shall remain internally unchanged and shall be printed directly on the front, left and right catcher faces.
requirements.source: user correction and supplied stacked SVG
requirements.verification: source path/color/transform inventory, uniform viewBox mapping, three-face registration and 3MF material audit

requirements.statement: The project shall load in Anycubic Slicer Next through a minimal core 3MF and shall include aligned STL parts as a fallback.
requirements.verification: ZIP/XML/reference audit plus documented Slicer Next import check

requirements.statement: Unknown machine-side hole spacing and keep-outs shall stay explicit and shall be tested with a low-material gauge before the catcher is printed.
requirements.verification: fit gauge, physical measurement and full-motion check

requirements.statement: Both functional parts shall print upright without generated supports using 0.4 mm nozzle PETG defaults.
requirements.verification: overhang proxy review and slicer preview

requirements.statement: Upper catcher walls shall use a visually apparent honeycomb reinforcement over a continuous containment skin while the funnel, impact rim, mounting plate and logo footprints remain protected.
requirements.verification: baseline/candidate mass comparison, skin continuity, honeycomb scale report and physical wall coupon

architecture.summary: Two independent stages: a lightweight honeycomb-reinforced, three-side-branded catcher above and a large freestanding bin below.
architecture.explicit_non_interface: No latch, hook or fastener joins the catcher to the lower bin; only the gravity drop path relates them.

assembly_sequence: Print the mount gauge and verify the two existing wiper-side screws, local clearance and hole coverage.
Print the white catcher body and the four unchanged SVG color regions on three faces in one aligned multicolor job.
Install only the catcher at the verified wiper-side mounting points with correctly engaged M3 hardware.
Confirm one upright, non-mirrored stacked lockup on each available face: front -Y, left -X and right/display +X.
Place the separate lower bin on the printer table directly under the catcher outlet with an unobstructed air gap.
Run full-motion checks and three supervised purge cycles before unattended use.

decision_log.basis: User clarified that only a small interceptor belongs at the purge outlet and the container must sit below.
The user requires the supplied stacked lockup without internal rearrangement on all three available exterior faces; the machine-side rear face remains reserved for mounting.

decision_log.topic: Machine hole spacing and local keep-out
decision_log.basis: Official replacement instructions identify the purge-wiper component but provide no dimensioned mounting drawing.
R1 used nested component assembly objects. R2 will use only direct mesh build items in a core 3MF and aligned STL fallbacks; actual Slicer Next import remains a user-side check.

Open cells could release thin purge fragments. Selected architecture uses a 1.0 mm continuous inner containment skin with 1.5 mm deep procedural honeycomb ribs; funnel, top/edge frames, mounting plate and exact logo footprints remain locally solid.

A neutral white body keeps all four supplied SVG colors visible. The exact visual variant therefore uses five materials and requires a five-or-more material workflow; four-slot machines cannot reproduce the exact logo plus distinct body color in one uninterrupted print.

validation.acceptance: two functional stages remain independent and every interface has one owner
all generated STL solids are nonempty, closed, consistently wound and positive-volume
the complete stacked source lockup is preserved at identical scale on front, left and right faces with no crop, rearrangement or outward-view mirroring
core package has only direct mesh build objects, valid XML and valid material/object/triangle references
Anycubic Slicer Next opens the file and shows one aligned multicolor catcher plus one separate bin
gauge, full motion and three supervised purge cycles pass
